# Hexabot Action Creator — build and review Hexabot v3 actions (short listing)

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the discovery manifest carries no verifiable license for this skill — the manifest makes faith, so no content is reproduced): @hexabot-ai's hexabot-action-creator skill, the action-authoring companion for the open-source Hexabot v3 chatbot platform. It teaches the agent to wrap business requirements as Hexabot actions: identify the capability, side effects, and target (Hexabot monorepo, custom action package, or standalone runtime); inspect the active project's real files as source of truth before final code; choose the right pattern (createAction for simple discovered actions, BaseAction for injected services, defineAction for standalone agentic examples); design the input/output/settings contract with idempotency, failure behavior, and logging; implement with Zod schemas and safe credential handling; and produce review findings ordered by severity.
